ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity white regions occupy the central-to-lateral portions of both lobes. A thick, continuous low-intensity black band defines the trailing edge and the central fluke region. Extensive fine-grained black mottling is present within the interior boundaries of the white regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a narrow vertex; bounding box depth approximately 15% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous jagged topography with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire span of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curves on both lobes sweeping upwards and outwards towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scarring are visible on the distal tip of the left lobe and along the upper margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible dark, vertical and diagonal linear disruptions intersecting the white pigmentation on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor notches and irregular indentations along the trailing edge topography, suggesting previous physical contact or wear.
